definitions.full: H7296. rohab [ רֹ֫הַב ] noun [masculine] Thes and others pride , i.e. object of pride; — suffix רָהְבָּם Psa 90:10 (compare ἠ ἀλαζονία τοῦ βίου 1John 2:16 ); < ᵑ9 ᵐ5 their width, extent ( רָחְבָּם ).
